actual_request.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Produce exactly ONE newly painted complete movement frame of 06_thunder_caster_boy for a sixteen-frame walk cycle. Single figure on one square transparent RGBA canvas; no sheet or montage.
Reference roles: image1 is the ORIGINAL CHARACTER IDENTITY and costume; image2 is the existing WEST idle only for camera, framing and short body proportions (do not copy its standing pose); image3 is the approved Jubaozhai painted-style sample, PRIMARY STYLE for clean rounded Q-style rendering and materials only, never include UI or any other character.
DIRECTION: WEST, strict side profile facing screen LEFT. Keep head, chest, belt, knees and both boot toes oriented LEFT with no frontal or back turn. The anatomical RIGHT hand holds the GOLD YIN-YANG SCEPTER with pointed lightning finial and turquoise bead; the anatomical LEFT hand holds the GOLD RECTANGULAR YIN-YANG TALISMAN. Preserve their hand ownership while rotating the character; do not simply mirror an east image or exchange props.
IDENTITY: playful amber-eyed boy, enormous round head, very short body/limbs, brown layered hair in high ponytail tied with gold/teal beads and yellow ribbon, gold forehead yin-yang medallion, ivory/gold cloud-pattern open robe, gold shoulder trim, long navy-violet sleeve lining, navy short puffy trousers with gold lightning motifs, gold belt/yin-yang pendants/turquoise beads, white ankle wraps and navy-gold chunky boots. Match original elaborate warm-gold shapes and textile painting.
EXACT PHASE W05 — correct LEFT-LEG SWING. The near anatomical LEFT leg belongs to the TALISMAN hand side: its hip starts at the SCREEN-RIGHT side of the pelvis beneath the talisman and large side yin-yang pendant. That near left thigh now moves IN FRONT OF and visibly overlaps the other far thigh, crossing diagonally toward screen LEFT into a lifted bent LEFT knee. Swinging LEFT boot is in the air at screen-left. The anatomical RIGHT leg belongs to the SCEPTER side and starts from the SCREEN-LEFT hip: it goes DOWN almost vertically to a planted supporting RIGHT boot approximately under the center-left pelvis, BEHIND the swinging left thigh. Crucial: the big near-left thigh must overlap and cover the far-right supporting thigh. Do NOT lift the scepter-side right thigh as in W13. The two hips retain original locations; independently redraw the crossed overlap and different trousers folds for actual opposite-leg movement.
REFERENCE4 is W01 scepter-side RIGHT forward contact, the strongest camera/body-scale reference. You must draw the opposite TALISMAN-SIDE LEFT leg moving forward, with the near-left thigh overlapping the far-right thigh. Keep head/torso/equipment size, draw new leg pose.
Consistent production framing: full silhouette including scepter and ponytail occupies about88% of square height, top around6% and lowest planted sole around94%; ample left/right space, no element touching any edge. Head and body proportions equal the old west idle and original portrait, no oversized closeup. Fixed camera distance and figure scale for all sixteen phases, only small natural gait bob. Original body robust/round and SHORT, not lanky.
OUTPUT: true transparent RGBA, native square at least1024x1024; prefer1254x1254. Foreground opaque solid with naturally antialiased edge. Clean brown/yellow/ivory/gold/navy colors, no magenta/pink fringe, no colored rim, checkerboard, floor, shadow, text, grid or frame. This must be a genuinely new independently drawn action, no copied pose, mirroring, warp or interpolation. Highest available painted visual fidelity.
